text: SoftBank falls 14.83%, Advantest 12.94%, Tokyo Electron 12.53%, SK Hynix 11.05% and Samsung 9.87%. Nvidia declines 4.65% premarket. European technology losses remain near 1%, while broader European indexes rise and U.S. defensive sectors register gains.

meta.note: Reported equity movements span different trading sessions and intraday measurement points.

text: The U.S. proposes country-specific Section 301 tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China, the EU, Japan and India. Proposed duties are non-stacking except for China, which faces an additional 20% levy with a conditional 40% rate tied to trade-truce compliance.

meta.note: Proposed tariff paramters are distinct from enacted duties; industrial overcapacity remains disputed.
